create_NaNCleaner_wrapper: create a NaNCleaner wrapper to remove NaNs from xarray datasets before prediction
build_NaNCleaner_with_reintroduce: build a NaNCleaner that cleans NaNs then reintroduces them in predictions using reintroduce_nans
run_NaNCleaner_call: run the NaNCleaner call method to get NaN-free predictions from an xarray dataset
test_NaNCleaner_loss: test the NaNCleaner loss method to compute loss on cleaned inputs and targets
review_NaNCleaner_clean: review the NaNCleaner _clean method that fills NaN values with a specified fill_value
